class.name: WaterVolume
class.brief_description: A body of water: put one anywhere a character should swim.
class.description: An [Area3D], so its shape is authored the way any trigger volume is. Dropping one into a level is the whole of making a character swim, because [WaterMovementTransition] is registered by default. The movement component does not connect to its signals - it asks the physics server which volume is at a point, every tick, from the transform it is simulating. See [method CharacterMovementComponent.find_water_volume_at] for why.

members.member: How strongly the water cancels gravity. 1.0 is neutral: a submerged character neither sinks nor rises, and one at the surface sinks until it is under and then hangs there. Below 1 it sinks, above 1 it floats up.
A current, in metres per second. Added to whatever the character is doing, so it drifts even while still.
